name: Torrid-Eyot
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by tectonic rift valleys. Farther poleward, past a subterranean ocean, the silence feels older than the soil.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Small darting fauna nest in the cliff-vents, timing their flights between gusts.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to the starship crash site (warship) are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
For traders, uranium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
